newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble lower but demand seen ahead of T-bill sales.
newsitem.headline: Rouble lower but demand seen ahead of T-bill sales.

text.p: The rouble edged down on Tuesday from Monday's close, but dealers said demand was persistent ahead of Wednesday's government securities auctions.
On Wednesday, the central bank will auction four trillion roubles ($707.3 million) of six-month paper and 7.5 trillion roubles of 10-month bills.
roubles/dollar Feb 18 midday Feb 18 early Feb 17 close
"Roubles are expensive today ahead of the auctions," Neftekhimbank dealer Boris Golub said. But he did not expect overnight rates to firm further.

Interbank Finance House chief dealer Mikhail Kulinich said banks were trading today roubles more actively to obtain funds for Wednesday's T-bill sales, while tomorrow settlement rates were stable during the day.
